title: PSD-Metacommunity-Dispersal_AI: MetaDiffusion for process-aware species-distribution reconstruction
description: A two-stage pipeline for process-aware species-distribution modelling with uncertainty. Stage 1 is a Lotka-Volterra individual-based metacommunity simulation; Stage 2 ("MetaDiffusion") is a conditional diffusion model that reconstructs full species range maps, with ensemble-based uncertainty, from a handful of records - with a focus on rare, range-restricted species.
